answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed if peers prove coordinated fake behavior, and release it only after months of distinct, useful work. A single honest agent risks little, but a sybil operator must lock up fresh capital for every puppet, turning a cheap flood into an expensive island chain where each island stands or falls alone. Like a reef that grows only from living coral, or a juniper that roots slowly in poor soil, trust here accumulates gradually and cannot be manufactured overnight.
